introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - Ordinary Level Examination. Computer Science (0595), Paper 3 (practical), June 2021. Duration: two and a half hours. Do all tasks (Task I, Task II, Task III) in this question paper.**

The booklet reproduced here contains three versions of the same practical paper, headed Group One, Group Two and Group Three (booklets GCE/P/2021/0595/3/C/Grp 1, Grp 2 and Grp 3). Each version has three tasks: Task I (word processing, 20 marks), Task II (spreadsheet, 20 marks) and Task III (reading and running a short C or Pascal program, 10 marks). A candidate works on one group only (the printed paper does not say how the groups are allotted).

Enter the information required in the shaded boxes. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. All written answers should be provided in the spaces provided in this question booklet. Calculators are NOT allowed.

The working files named in the tasks (the picture 'CornerShop' found on the desktop, Group Two Task II) are supplied on the day; they are not reproduced in the printed paper.
enonce_intro_markdown:
**GROUP ONE - TASK II (20 marks)**

An examination board registers candidates for the Ordinary level and Advanced level. Candidates are expected to pay a registration fee for each level, a subject fee (which is a product of the number of subjects and the fee per subject for that level), a practical fee for subjects that have practical paper (see Figure 2).

![fig-1](gce-ol-computer-science-2021-p3-officiel-cameroun_exercice_G1-T2_fig_1.png)

**Figure 2**

The number of subjects offered by some two candidates and the fees due are shown above.

Page de garde verifiee : ORDINARY LEVEL, COMPUTER SCIENCE, 0595, Paper 3, juin 2021, 2h30. Transcrites en neuf fichiers : numero_exercice G1-T1, G1-T2, G1-T3, G2-T1, ..., G3-T3 ; groupes ["GROUP 1"], ["GROUP 2"] ou ["GROUP 3"]. Le sujet n'impose pas expressement de ne traiter qu'une version (le candidat ne passe en pratique qu'un groupe) : non exprimable, regles_choix reste vide. De meme, a la Task III le sujet dit « Select any one of them » (programme C ou Pascal) : non exprimable.

Les filigranes gcerevision.com / Kawlo, les cadres d'en-tete (numero de centre, nom du candidat, « For examiners' use only »), les lignes a completer, les textes fantomes du verso (le papier est translucide) et les artefacts de scanner sont ignores. Le fichier-image « CornerShop » (Group Two, Task II) et les fichiers du bureau ne figurent pas dans le PDF.

Aucun logiciel (traitement de texte, tableur) n'a ete execute : les menus et les etapes sont donnes de memoire (Office recent) et ne sont pas testes. Les formules de tableur ont ete traduites en Python et executees sur les donnees du sujet (totaux, moyennes, calcul des frais, tri). Aucun compilateur C ou Pascal n'est disponible : les programmes du sujet n'ont pas ete compiles, leur logique a ete verifiee par une simulation Python fidele (division entiere et reste, memes entrees, memes sorties) dont les resultats sont recopies dans les corriges.
Aucun corrige officiel n'existe : les reponses sont redigees. Les repartitions de points dans les corriges (« marking idea ») sont indicatives ; les points imprimes du sujet ne sont jamais modifies.

Pascal : les entiers du programme sont declares « integer ». Sur un compilateur a entiers de 16 bits (maximum 32767, cas d'anciens Turbo Pascal ou du mode par defaut de certains compilateurs) une entree comme 45678 (Group One) provoque un depassement ; sur un compilateur a entiers de 32 bits (cas usuel, et int en C) le resultat est celui donne. Le corrige indique la sortie attendue sur une machine a entiers de 32 bits. En Pascal ISO la largeur d'affichage par defaut d'un entier est definie par l'implementation : le corrige suppose l'affichage sans blancs de tete (cas usuel).
Task II, Group One : les points imprimes (5 + 2 + 6 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 20) correspondent a l'en-tete ; la question 8 (save and print) n'a pas de points.

Figure 2 : le scan est sur papier translucide (texte fantome du verso visible) ; la figure est REDESSINEE a l'identique (memes tableaux, memes titres, memes valeurs, memes lettres de colonnes et numeros de lignes) plutot que recadree, pour eviter les traces du verso. Valeurs relues sur le scan a fort grossissement : 11 / 2 et 5 / 4 ; 8000 / 9000, 1000 / 2000, 5000 / 5000.

La disposition exacte des cellules (adresses B2:D5, F2:H6, B8:G11) est deduite de la figure (lettres de colonnes A a I, lignes 1 a 12) : les formules du corrige (C10 = C4, D10 = G4, E10 = C10*G5, F10 = D4*G6, G10 = SUM(D10:F10)) en dependent. La « practical fee » est lue comme (nombre de practicals) x (practical fee du niveau) ; la monnaie n'est pas indiquee. Le sujet dit « the three tables » et « the cell C4 and C5 » : lus tels quels.

questions.enonce_markdown: Open a spreadsheet application and type the three tables.  *[5 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Start the spreadsheet (for example *Microsoft Excel*) and type the three tables of Figure 2 **at the same cell addresses**, because the later formulas refer to them:

| Table | Where | Content |
|---|---|---|
| SUBJECTS OFFERED | B2:D5 | title in B2 (merged over B2:D2); headers LEVEL, NUMBER OF SUBJECTS, NUMBER OF PRACTICALS in B3:D3; B4 = O, C4 = 11, D4 = 2; B5 = A, C5 = 5, D5 = 4 |
| FEES DUE | F2:H6 | title in F2 (merged over F2:H2); G3 = O LEVEL, H3 = A LEVEL; F4 = REGISTRATION FEE (G4 = 8000, H4 = 9000); F5 = FEE PER SUBJECT (G5 = 1000, H5 = 2000); F6 = PRACTICAL FEE (G6 = 5000, H6 = 5000) |
| FEES TO BE PAID | B8:G11 | title in B8 (merged over B8:G8); headers NUMBER OF SUBJECTS, REGISTRATION FEE, SUBJECT FEE, PRACTICAL FEE, TOTAL PER CANDIDATE in C9:G9; B10 = O LEVEL CANDIDATE, B11 = A LEVEL CANDIDATE; C10:G11 left empty (they are filled by formulae in the next questions) |

Add the borders and centre the titles as in the figure (*Home* > *Borders* > *All Borders*, *Merge & Center*). Leave the empty cells empty: do not type numbers in them.

*Marking idea:* one mark per correctly typed table with its headings and layout, and the rest for the accuracy of the numbers (indicative split).

questions.enonce_markdown: Enter a formula to copy the value of cells C4 and C5 into cells C10 and C11.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Click **C10** and type `=C4`, press *Enter*; click **C11** and type `=C5`, press *Enter*.

Result: C10 shows **11** and C11 shows **5**, the number of subjects of the Ordinary and Advanced level candidates. If C4 or C5 is changed later, C10 and C11 follow automatically.

questions.enonce_markdown: Use appropriate formulae to fill the cells D10, D11, E10, E11, F10 and F11.  *[6 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Each cell of the table FEES TO BE PAID takes its data from the two tables above it:

| Cell | Meaning | Formula | Value |
|---|---|---|---|
| D10 | registration fee, O level | `=G4` | 8000 |
| D11 | registration fee, A level | `=H4` | 9000 |
| E10 | subject fee, O level = number of subjects x fee per subject | `=C10*G5` | 11 x 1000 = 11000 |
| E11 | subject fee, A level | `=C11*H5` | 5 x 2000 = 10000 |
| F10 | practical fee, O level = number of practicals x practical fee | `=D4*G6` | 2 x 5000 = 10000 |
| F11 | practical fee, A level | `=D5*H6` | 4 x 5000 = 20000 |

The O level row and the A level row use different columns of FEES DUE (G for O, H for A), so the formulae of row 10 cannot simply be copied down to row 11: type each one, or adjust the column letter after copying. (The values above were recomputed with a Python simulation of the formulae.) One mark per cell.

questions.enonce_markdown: Write the formulae you entered for E10 and E11.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
**E10:** `=C10*G5`

**E11:** `=C11*H5`

(Number of subjects of the candidate multiplied by the fee per subject of his or her level. Equivalent answers that give the same values, such as `=C4*G5` and `=C5*H5`, are also correct.)

questions.enonce_markdown: Enter formulae in cells G10 and G11 to calculate the total examination fees for the two candidates.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The total per candidate is the sum of the registration fee, the subject fee and the practical fee:

Click **G10** and type `=SUM(D10:F10)`; click **G11** and type `=SUM(D11:F11)`.

Values (Python simulation of the table): **G10 = 8000 + 11000 + 10000 = 29000** and **G11 = 9000 + 10000 + 20000 = 39000**.

questions.enonce_markdown: Write the formulae you entered in (5) in the spaces below.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
**G10:** `=SUM(D10:F10)`

**G11:** `=SUM(D11:F11)`

(`=D10+E10+F10` and `=D11+E11+F11` are equivalent and also accepted.)

questions.enonce_markdown: In the Subject Offered table change Ordinary level number of subjects to 10 and corresponding number of practical papers to 1. What is the total paid by this Ordinary level candidate?  *[1 mark]*
Save your work as Task 2 in your working directory and print a copy
questions.corrige_markdown: *File* > **Save As**, choose the working directory (the *Candidate folder*), type the file name **Task 2** and save. Then *File* > **Print** and print one copy, with the formulae results visible. No mark is printed for this step.
